Flow.description: Transfer leads arrive two ways: the Dialpad webhook assigns a pool-owned lead to whoever answered (it stamps Transfer Picked Up By itself), or Talk IT Pro creates the lead already owned by the LO who took the call. This flow covers the second path, recording the answerer at insert. Owner keeps moving afterwards - redistributions, merges, offboarding book moves - so reporting on Owner credits the wrong person; this field never moves. Skips pool-owned leads (nobody answered yet) and queue-owned leads.
